title: Voice Analysis in Patients With Neurologic Diseases
brief_summary: In this observational pilot study, the investigators will record and assess voice samples from healthy participants and those participants affected by neurologic diseases to evaluate possible differences in voice features.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Clinical diagnosis of neurologic disorders

Exclusion Criteria:

* smoking
* bilateral/unilateral hearing loss
* respiratory disorders
* conditions affecting the vocal cords, including nodules.
study_population: We will recruit neurologic patients not taking any oral medications or alcohol and any drugs acting on the central nervous system at the time of the study.
